name: What is obstetric malpractice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Obstetric malpractice occurs when a healthcare provider's negligence during pregnancy, labor, or delivery causes injury or harm to the mother or baby. This can include failure to diagnose a condition, improper use of delivery tools, delayed C-section, or medication errors. If a healthcare professional's actions fall below the accepted standard of care, leading to preventable harm, it may be considered malpractice. Each case is unique and requires a thorough review of medical records to determine if negligence occurred.
acceptedAnswer.description: Obstetric malpractice involves healthcare provider negligence during pregnancy or childbirth that results in injury to the mother or baby.
